rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00035, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1080, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). START FROM iter-7 CHAMPION (c24/ep5/k2/lr2.16e-4, hr 0.8469). ONE KNOB: lr 0.00021567 -> 0.00035 (~1.6x higher learning rate). All else = iter-7 champion exactly (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-6 (c24/ep4): 0.8385. iter-7 (c24/ep5): 0.8469=CHAMPION, SSIM 0.9983, PSNR 52.63, elapsed 939.5s=15.7min. iter-8 (c32/ep3): 0.8085 REGRESS -- capacity beyond c=24 is too under-trained at the epochs the wall allows, so c=24 is the capacity SWEET SPOT and the architecture axes (itnet_k=2 optimal per iter-4, unet_c=24 optimal per iter-6/7/8) are now BOUNDED. (2) FAILURE MODE: the remaining under-exploited lever is the TRAINING RECIPE. The c24/ep5 net is EPOCH-BUDGET-LIMITED (epochs still climbing at ep5 but the 20-min wall caps ~ep5-6 at c24). A HIGHER lr can reach a lower training loss in the SAME 5 epochs -> effectively buys convergence the epoch budget can't. lr has been fixed at the TPE-seed 2.16e-4 since iter-1 and never tuned on this redo split. (3) ONE KNOB: lr 2.16e-4 -> 3.5e-4 (~1.6x). c/k/epochs/train_n all held so any hr change isolates the lr effect. grad_clip=1.0 retained guards the higher lr against the occasional exploding-gradient step from the FBP adjoint in dc_step. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lr=3.5e-4 lifts hr above 0.8469 because the c24 net is epoch-budget-limited and a higher lr converges further within the fixed 5-epoch budget. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8469 at lr=3.5e-4, either the higher lr overshoots (unstable / worse) -> iter-10 tries a LOWER lr (1.5e-4) instead, or lr is already near-optimal -> iter-10 pivots to alpha_init (the DC step size). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): IDENTICAL config to iter-7 except the lr scalar (no compute change) -> elapsed ~= 939.5s = 15.7min < 1200s, same ~4min margin. max_train_s=1080 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-9 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-10.
